title: ZO Skin Centre
summary: A premium website redesign for ZO Skin Centre aimed at increasing online appointment bookings and creating a seamless experience.
goal: Increase online appointment bookings, unify multiple clinic locations into a seamless browsing experience, and highlight key services.

targetUsers.label: Patients (25–65)
targetUsers.description: Looking for skincare treatments, trustworthy dermatologists, and easy appointment booking.

targetUsers.label: Dermatologists
targetUsers.description: Professionals whose credibility and expertise needed to be showcased.

discoveryNote: I collaborated directly with the clinic manager to understand current challenges.
insights: Users often struggled with booking appointments online.
Multiple location pages caused confusion and increased bounce rate.
Visitors wanted to easily browse treatments, view results, and read patient reviews in one place.
competitorAnalysis: Competitor sites leaned heavily on strong imagery and simplified booking flows, which became a benchmark for this redesign.

personas.name: Maya
personas.motivations: Trust signals — reviews, before and after photos.

personas.name: Rahman
personas.wants: Clear details about treatments and doctors.

userFlows.name: Book a Consultation
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Select service → Choose doctor → Fill booking form

userFlows.name: Explore Treatments
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Treatments page → Detailed service info → View gallery

userFlows.name: View Results
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Gallery / Before & After → Filter by treatment

userFlows.name: Read Reviews
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Testimonials section → Filter by treatment or doctor

wireframes: Low-fidelity sketches were developed first to map the layout.
Focused on placing the booking CTA prominently and consolidating all clinic locations on the homepage.
Iterated wireframes into mid and high-fidelity prototypes before final UI.
visualDirection: Built trust through clean white space, modern typography, and medical-inspired accents.
Maintained alignment with the parent brand's theme, but applied unique elements to differentiate ZO Skin Centre.

keyScreens.name: Homepage
keyScreens.description: Unified entry point highlighting services, locations, and appointment booking.

keyScreens.name: Treatments Page
keyScreens.description: Structured grid with service descriptions and direct Book Now CTAs.

keyScreens.name: Doctors Page
keyScreens.description: Professional profiles showcasing credentials and experience.

keyScreens.name: Booking Form
keyScreens.description: Simplified step-by-step form optimized for mobile.

keyScreens.name: Reviews Page
keyScreens.description: Authentic patient testimonials with filtering.

keyScreens.name: Gallery
keyScreens.description: Before and after results in an organized, trust-building format.

keyScreens.name: Contact Page
keyScreens.description: Consolidated locations with maps and seamless navigation.

expectedOutcomes.label: Reduced confusion
expectedOutcomes.description: All locations accessible directly from the homepage.

expectedOutcomes.label: Increased trust
expectedOutcomes.description: Stronger focus on results, reviews, and doctors.

expectedOutcomes.label: Visual upgrade
expectedOutcomes.description: Premium, medical-luxury look aligned with brand identity.

title: Ibadat
summary: A prayer and lifestyle app designed for Muslims to track prayer times, access authentic duas, and manage notifications seamlessly.
goal: Create a seamless, modern Islamic app to support daily prayers, provide authentic duas, and integrate smart features for a better spiritual experience.

targetUsers.label: Muslims (15–65)
targetUsers.description: Seeking accurate prayer times, easy access to duas, and distraction-free prayer experiences.

targetUsers.label: Mosque-goers
targetUsers.description: Benefiting from automatic silent mode and alerts when entering the mosque.

discoveryNote: I collaborated with the client to refine the vision and understand user expectations.
insights: Users wanted a distraction-free prayer experience without manual phone adjustments.
Prayer time accuracy and localization were crucial.
Authenticity and accessibility of duas needed to be clear, with references to Quran and Hadith.
A personal feed could engage users by providing insights and reminders tied to Islamic dates and events.
competitorAnalysis: Existing apps provided prayer times but lacked innovation and personalization.
Few apps integrated mosque-based silent mode or customizable dua collections.

personas.name: Ayesha
personas.wants: Accurate prayer alerts, dua references, and a distraction-free mosque experience.
personas.preferences: Clean, modern interface with easy navigation.
personas.motivations: Staying consistent with prayers while balancing student life.

personas.name: Karim
personas.wants: Automatic silent mode in mosques and a personalized dua collection.
personas.preferences: Reliable app with minimal effort required.
personas.motivations: Integrating faith into a busy work schedule.

userFlows.name: Prayer Times & Alerts
userFlows.steps: Launch app → Enable location → Prayer times displayed → Notifications set

userFlows.name: Mosque Silent Mode
userFlows.steps: User enters mosque → App detects location → Phone switches to silent automatically

userFlows.name: Browse Duas
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Dua collection → Select dua → View reference and translation → Save to personal list

userFlows.name: Explore Feed
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Feed section → Weekly / monthly / yearly Islamic insights → Engage with content

wireframes: Designed low-fidelity wireframes for prayer time screens, dua collection, and feed.
Focused on reducing clutter and emphasizing readability.
Progressed into high-fidelity designs with a consistent Islamic visual style.
visualDirection: Calm colors, clean typography, and intuitive iconography.
Focused on accessibility and easy navigation for a wide age range.

keyScreens.name: Prayer Times Screen
keyScreens.description: Accurate, location-based times with alerts.

keyScreens.name: Dua Collection
keyScreens.description: Indexed library with references, translations, and editable options.

keyScreens.name: Feed
keyScreens.description: Weekly, monthly, and yearly insights tied to Islamic events.

keyScreens.name: Silent Mode Feature
keyScreens.description: Automatic detection of mosque entry with toggle control.

keyScreens.name: Settings
keyScreens.description: Multiple methods for calculating prayer times, customizable alerts, and personalization.

expectedOutcomes.label: Distraction-free prayers
expectedOutcomes.description: Automatic silent mode enhances the experience in mosques.

expectedOutcomes.label: Authenticity
expectedOutcomes.description: Verified duas with references increase trust.

expectedOutcomes.label: Personalization
expectedOutcomes.description: Users can adjust translations and settings to their needs.

expectedOutcomes.label: Engagement
expectedOutcomes.description: The feed section fosters long-term interaction with the app.

expectedOutcomes.label: Scalability
expectedOutcomes.description: Future updates can expand features such as community or event integrations.

title: Alokito Teacher
summary: A complete redesign of Alokito Teacher's website, adding a new job portal feature to connect teachers with opportunities.
goal: Refresh the brand with a modern, engaging design, improve consistency, and introduce new functionality including pricing plans and a teacher-focused job portal.

targetUsers.label: Teachers (22–50)
targetUsers.description: Seeking training courses, resources, and career opportunities.

targetUsers.label: Institutions and schools
targetUsers.description: Looking to hire trained teachers through the job portal.

discoveryNote: I collaborated directly with the client to gather feedback and requirements.
insights: The old design felt outdated and lacked consistency with the brand's fun and modern identity.
Teachers wanted a simple way to browse and purchase courses.
The job portal needed to provide an easy search-and-apply experience.
Pricing packages were essential to highlight, as the client wanted to push high-value course bundles.
competitorAnalysis: Education platforms with strong visual branding and clear navigation were benchmarks.
Job portals emphasized clean search and filtering to minimize friction.

personas.name: Rina
personas.wants: Affordable training courses and an easy course purchase flow.
personas.preferences: Fun, engaging design with straightforward navigation.
personas.motivations: Career growth and recognition through certified courses.

personas.name: Arif
personas.wants: A reliable platform to find trained teachers.
personas.preferences: Job portal with efficient filters and application tracking.

userFlows.name: Browse Courses
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Courses page → Course detail → Enroll / Purchase

userFlows.name: Explore Pricing Packages
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Pricing page → Select plan → Checkout

userFlows.name: Job Search & Apply
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Job portal → Search and filter jobs → Apply

userFlows.name: Institution Hiring Flow
userFlows.steps: Job portal → Post job listing → Manage applications

wireframes: Created low-fidelity wireframes for homepage, courses, pricing, and job portal.
Mapped out consistent layouts to reflect the fun, educational brand identity.
Iterated into high-fidelity prototypes with feedback from client and stakeholders.
visualDirection: Fun, modern, and consistent with the educational brand.
Clean typography, bright accents, and approachable UI.
Fully responsive design for a mobile-first experience.

keyScreens.description: Highlights courses, job portal access, and pricing.

keyScreens.name: Courses Page
keyScreens.description: Grid-based layout with categories and quick enroll options.

keyScreens.description: Showcases single courses and bundled packages.

keyScreens.name: Job Portal
keyScreens.description: Search and filter jobs with a direct application flow.

keyScreens.description: Simplified job apply form optimized for teachers.

expectedOutcomes.description: Streamlined course purchase and job application flows.

expectedOutcomes.label: Modern design
expectedOutcomes.description: Fun, consistent branding across all pages.

expectedOutcomes.label: New revenue opportunities
expectedOutcomes.description: Highlighted high-value pricing plans and packages.

expectedOutcomes.label: Career connection
expectedOutcomes.description: Enabled teachers to find and apply for jobs directly on the platform.

expectedOutcomes.label: Responsive experience
expectedOutcomes.description: Optimized across devices for teachers on mobile.

title: TaxRise
summary: A complete redesign of TaxRise Inc's website to modernize the brand presence, improve consistency, and boost conversions.
goal: Modernize the website, improve consistency across all pages, and increase conversion rates while staying competitive in the industry.

targetUsers.label: Clients (25–60)
targetUsers.description: Looking for trustworthy tax resolution services, clear information, and easy ways to get started.

targetUsers.label: Internal teams (SEO and marketing)
targetUsers.description: Needed a site aligned with brand strategy, optimized for conversions, and scalable for campaigns.

discoveryNote: I collaborated closely with stakeholders, the SEO team, and the marketing team to gather insights.
insights: The previous design lacked consistency across pages, which reduced trust.
Conversion flows were not optimized, leading to drop-offs.
SEO and marketing required a flexible site structure to support campaigns.
competitorAnalysis: Competitors leaned into modern, professional layouts with strong trust signals and clear CTAs.
Benchmarking highlighted the need for a stronger visual identity and a smoother onboarding flow.

personas.name: John
personas.wants: Clear explanation of services and a quick way to connect with experts.
personas.preferences: Professional and modern design that instills trust.

personas.name: Linda
personas.wants: Easy-to-understand steps to resolve tax issues.
personas.motivations: Assurance through reviews, case studies, and visible expertise.

userFlows.name: Request Consultation
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Services → Select service → Contact form

userFlows.name: Learn About Services
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Services overview → Individual service detail page

userFlows.name: Build Trust
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Reviews / Testimonials → Case Studies → Contact

userFlows.name: Resources Access
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Blog / Knowledge Base → Read articles → Lead capture form

wireframes: Started with low-fidelity wireframes to define site structure and layout.
Prioritized placement of CTAs and trust elements such as reviews and credentials.
Iterated into high-fidelity prototypes with stakeholder feedback.
visualDirection: Comprehensive style guide developed for typography, colors, components, and layouts.
Emphasis on trust-building visuals: client testimonials, success metrics, and case highlights.

keyScreens.name: Homepage
keyScreens.description: Clean hero section with a clear CTA, overview of services, and trust elements.

keyScreens.name: Services Page
keyScreens.description: Grid-based layout with detailed explanations and direct CTAs.

keyScreens.name: About Page
keyScreens.description: Company story, credibility markers, and team highlights.

keyScreens.name: Testimonials / Case Studies
keyScreens.description: Organized for easy browsing to reinforce credibility.

keyScreens.name: Blog / Resources
keyScreens.description: Structured for SEO and easy content consumption.

keyScreens.name: Contact Page
keyScreens.description: Simple, mobile-friendly forms with clear CTAs.

expectedOutcomes.description: Unified style across roughly 30 unique screens.

expectedOutcomes.label: Increased trust
expectedOutcomes.description: Stronger brand presence through modern design and testimonials.

expectedOutcomes.label: Conversion-focused
expectedOutcomes.description: Clearer CTAs and better-structured service pages.

expectedOutcomes.label: Scalability
expectedOutcomes.description: Site aligned with SEO and marketing needs for ongoing campaigns.
